groups.comparison: Fresh canonical Seed/Stream/RNG definitions read in full. Seed all64bit words incl0 with word-order/hash eightlittleendian authority, StreamId nonempty static purpose; exact application generation/replay entropy owner already retained through all five puzzle families. Native draw words/hash byte lengths/index/bitmask/permutation arithmetic are true numerical representation, not application identity. UnitInterval Core dependency would cycle and f64 draws must keep53bit precision; no substitute f32 fraction. Existing puzzle closed vocabularies match, but puzzle capacity/weight/index/rulesversion/submissionrevision/counts do not match rig/geometric/tick/physical units. Source-specific bounds and invalid-submission policy persist as missing-owner findings, notclearance. Reuse exact checked Seed vocabulary; preserve wire/draw count/order/framing and solver ties. SamplingError has exact native empty/zero/overflow sourceclasses. Panic/assert/unreachable remain later Rule/admission problems.

groups.comparison: Fresh SourcePackageDigest53 and digest28 actualdefinitions: exactly lowercase64hex, no normalization, allzero lexicalword valid, Deserialize rerunsfrom_hex. Exact package identity owner fits TerrainPack/Manifest.package_sha256 and RoadPack source binding; valid_digest discards already checkedvalue and later rawretention/readmission is ROOTPP016. Content/chunk/geometry/scene identities have different authority even same lexicalleaf: share representation separately without substituting package identity. Native SHA bytes and terminal lowercaseformat are actual codecs, IO readbuffer sizes native metadata; helper returnsString is only valid where final source role is separately assigned, not blanket application waiver.

groups.name: dispatcher_checked_coordinate_cause_source_authority
groups.comparison: Existing Wgs84CoordinateE7 exact after sourcequantization; checked producer get -> raw build_imported_scene -> same admission remains exact migration gap ROOTPP010. Retain object across all callers; native CLI i32 parse at true ingress only. Source elevation absolute datum differs Scene elevation/relativeoffset; RegionalTerrainRequest/Scale preserve Optioncoverage holes. StrategicMinute absolute simulationclock differs SDKTimestamp/hostInstant and sourceGrid extent/count. MissionId prefixmission/lowercase128 rejects supported capture/startup/settlement source keys, so notexact; missing scene-preparation/source identity must retain authority selecting settlement seed versus mission key. Keep canonical SourcePackageDigest and distinct scenecontent digest; typed terrain/source/geometry/CityCompile/HomeCatalog/IO/serde cause must survive internal APIs rather than String until process/log/HTTP display. PlanExtents zero fits computed vista halfwidth/depth; Position<Scene>/Architectural frames do not merge.
